BiblicalUsage: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto the wicked man when he is carried to the grave, and God asks who can hold the dust when it groweth into hardness and the clods cleave fast together.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the grave's clods are sweet to no one, and the earth itself waits on God's word to open or to hold fast.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
